benefits.title: Flexible hours
benefits.body: Core overlap from 11am to 4pm. The rest is yours to arrange.

benefits.title: Remote-friendly
benefits.body: Work from the studio, from home, or somewhere in between.

benefits.title: Learning budget
benefits.body: An annual budget for courses, conferences and books, with no approval theatre.

benefits.title: Health cover
benefits.body: Private health cover for you and immediate family, from day one.

jobs.title: Senior UI/UX Designer
jobs.summary: Own product engagements end to end — research, flows, interface design and the component library that ships with them.
responsibilities: Lead design on two to three engagements at a time
Run research sessions and turn findings into decisions
Build and maintain component libraries with real states
Present and defend work directly to clients
Mentor two designers on the team
requirements: Five or more years designing digital products
A portfolio of shipped work, not concepts
Fluency in Figma and design-system practice
Comfortable running a client workshop alone
Working knowledge of accessibility standards

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.summary: Build fast, accessible front-ends in Next.js and TypeScript, and help keep our performance budgets honest.
responsibilities: Build client projects in Next.js and TypeScript
Translate design systems into component libraries
Keep Core Web Vitals inside agreed budgets
Review pull requests and raise the bar
Integrate headless CMS platforms and third-party APIs
requirements: Three or more years with React in production
Strong TypeScript and modern CSS
Real accessibility experience, not just an audit tool
Comfortable owning a build from setup to launch
Clear written communication — much of the team is remote

jobs.title: Email Developer
jobs.summary: Hand-build responsive email and Veeva content that renders correctly everywhere it lands.
responsibilities: Hand-code responsive email templates
Test across major clients, devices and dark mode
Build and maintain modular template libraries
Produce Veeva Approved Email and CLM content
Document handover for client ESP teams
requirements: Two or more years building production email
Deep familiarity with Outlook and Gmail quirks
Comfortable with table-based layout and MSO conditionals
Experience with at least one major ESP
Careful, methodical QA habits

jobs.title: Motion Designer
jobs.summary: Produce launch films, product demos and interface motion, and write the specs engineering builds from.
responsibilities: Storyboard and animate client films
Design interface motion and hand over timed specs
Direct sound design and music selection
Maintain the studio's motion guidelines
Work alongside designers from the concept stage
requirements: Three or more years in motion design
A reel showing narrative work, not just loops
After Effects fluency and clean project hygiene
Experience exporting Lottie or CSS-ready animation
Available for an initial six-month contract
